name: lost-skulls-r0-lock-and-lighter
description: Isle of Lost Skulls room 0 (Pirate1 Hallway1): punch the jail padlock, push through the jail door, follow the hallway to the cannon room, clear the pirates, aim the cannon with its handle (turning at the wield point), release it, then carry the lighter to the wick (closed-loop light-wick) so the original lighter logic fires the cannon.
notes: Path from a top-down heightmap of the level56 collision meshes (game/reports/quest-scene-56-inventory.json + sharedassets56 meshes, read offline): jail x 143.5-149.5 z 46.7-53.5 (floor -3.5); jail bars x 149.55 (door z 46.8-48.17, lock (149.48,-2.48,47.98)); corridor x 149.6-153.3 z 39.7-53.5; hallway x 153.3-167 z 42.8-46.8 ramping up to -1.92 around x 157-160; hall x 167-185 z 40.7-48.9; gap x 177-180 z 39.7-40.7 into the cannon room x 174.3-182.5 z 36.2-40.7.

Atlas (game/reports/quest-atlas/lost-skulls.md room 0): [BreakableLockEncounter] TrapEncounterStartTrigger at (149.55,-3.50,48.18) -> UnlockDoorEncounterStep; the room finish OPEN_DOOR requires Encounter6 (enemies). Whether the jail door opens by pushing is NOT verified (live pass 6: padlock destroyed, gate stayed closed). A stuck result at the door is expected evidence.

routefix (live 20261008T042513Z): the hall leg (167,44.8) -> (176.5,44.6) ran through the [Barrel_Wine_Faded] cover cluster around the Pillar (174.45,45.16): SM64 wall push-out between the 0.6-0.9 m barrel boxes moved Mario 1.38 m in one tick (to 0.5 m beyond the barrel at (174.14,45.43)), he then stuck at (175.0,45.95) by the post at x 174.8-175.1 and took a hit at (175.1,-0.3,46.0). The leg now uses the south lane z 42.9 (x 169.5-178.5 clear of every active non-trigger box collider within 0.5 m between 0.25 and 1.6 m above the floor, level56 inventory; not verified live).
Native SM64 input only. Launch: -Quest lost-skulls -QuestStart -QuestRoom 0 -MarioFollow -MarioCombat -MarioCarry (-MarioQaImmortal for unattended QA).

Cannon (1) (authored level56 decode): base (178.28,-1.92,38.02); swivel pivot = sphereOrigin CannonPivot (178.341,-0.776,38.018); handle [CannonHandle] (177.910,-0.746,38.054), yaw +-45, pitch +-30, kinematic (stays where released); screen wield point EnemyWieldTransform (177.547,-1.916,38.084); wick = QuestCannon.wickTransform = .../Fuse/FuseStart (178.155,-0.435,38.061) at rest = 1.575 m above Mario's floor (-2.01), 0.388 m from the pivot (rides the cannon aim); lighter (177.67,-1.68,37.29), TipTransform lighter-local (0,0.266,0); QuestCannonLighter wickLightDistance 0.1 compared with the SQUARED tip-wick distance (reach 0.316 m).

SM64 light hold (native probe of the carry native 4abca73f): HOLP forward 0.47, right 0.14, up 0.67-0.75 m from the feet in ACT_HOLD_IDLE; ACT_HOLD_JUMP apex by A hold 0.965/1.275/1.55/1.79/1.99/2.42 m (holdA 1..5, >=7), the HOLP rising with the feet. Where the tip sits relative to the HOLP depends on the authored grip (Default pickup pose (0,0,0.219) q(0.5,-0.5,-0.5,0.5)) and is NOT verified live, so light-wick measures it (mario-carry wick-distance tipMario=fwd,right,up) and aligns on the measured offset.

v4 steps 33/35/37 failed not-ready 0x08000207 (ACT_HOLD_IDLE; the jump entry rule did not know the hold actions) and the handle was dropped by the NON-ORIGINAL [P] 1.5 m leash (log line 'SM64 hand 1.50 m from handle pivot'): the aim walk to (177.35,38.55) faced away from the cannon. The aim now turns in place at the wield point; the lighter goes last because grabbing the handle makes the original FireCannonScreenController pick the lighter into the participant's off hand and its OnStop resets the lighter to the holster.

long tools (lighter, torch) are held pointing FORWARD along Mario's facing. Live v5/v6 showed the [P] hand-transform write does not place a held tool (its RigidbodyPickup target followed the written hand but the lighter stayed at the screen hand pose, tip ~1.82 m above the floor at a world-fixed offset from Mario's feet); the carry now writes the held tool's own holder-space offset (RigidbodyPickup HolderSpacePickupPosition/Rotation, [P2]) so the ORIGINAL pickup follow puts the grip at the SM64 HOLP and the shaft forward: expected tipMario ~ (0.74, -0.08, 0.67) in ACT_HOLD_IDLE, need = 1.575 - 0.67 = 0.905 m -> holdA 1 (feet apex 0.965 m, ~5 native ticks within 0.08 m of the wick). Approach side from the level56 inventory + live v6 step 30 (goto to the wield point stuck at x 177.38): the barrel box x 177.82-178.74 z 37.56-38.48 (0.27-0.98 m above the floor) keeps Mario's centre at x <= ~177.35 from the -X side, so the tip reaches x ~178.09 vs the wick 178.125 (error ~0.04 m); from +Z the barrel/base keep him at z >= ~38.98 (tip error ~0.2 m), so yaw 90 goes first and yaw 180 is only a fallback. Not verified live.

Round 2 (live v7, bundle 5f5ab44d): [P2] works (holderSpaceWritten=1, long-hold err=0) but the stationary tool alternated every Unity frame +-0.22 m around its target (the screen hand is posed differently at the pickup's LateUpdate; ~2 m lever): the carry now recovers the LateUpdate holder pose from the tool root and predicts the two-frame cycle (HolderFramePredictor). light-wick: stand point from the averaged settled tip offset plus the hop crossing shift (-0.07 fwd, +0.03 right, +0.05 up, re-learned per hop) on the live (aimed) wick 178.050,-0.526,37.959; a stuck/unreachable stand point re-plans the facing (back off along the stuck ray, or untried approaches +-35/70 deg around the wick via a 1.3 m ring detour) instead of failing; each hop's take-off shifts by one tick so the 4-tick tool frames sample different phases. Lighting before aiming was not chosen: the shot would leave the unaimed cannon; the step reads the wick where the aim put it. Not verified live.

steps.text: skulls r0: jail spawn, walking to the padlock
padlock punched; B press at the door, then pushing through it
cannon room: clear the pirate encounter before touching the lighter (an enemy hit makes SM64 drop held objects)
cannon aim: handle first (screen wield point, turn to swing the handle; the lighter waits in its holster)
handle held: turning in place at the wield point (hand stays within 0.9 m of the pivot; leash 1.5 m)
aim set (hand toward -Z of the handle rest side -> muzzle toward the +Z doorway); releasing the handle (B)
lighter: from its holster (the original FireCannonScreenController.OnStop resets it there) to the wick
lighter held forward ([P2]); light-wick from the -X side (yaw 90) on the LIVE wick; a blocked stand point is re-planned (other facing / ring detour), not failed
